comment: Golden-run replay of examples/neon-drift-arena. Read by scripts/golden/replay_developer.py. This file is a mapping only: the Factory holds no game source. `copy` entries are taken from the game repository's own examples/neon-drift-arena/ (the template ships them) and written with a provenance header. `overlays` are directories of the game repository - shipped by the pinned web-game-template commit - holding the hand-made adaptation to the template layout the development brief asks for; each is copied onto the repository root in order (a later one wins), its README.md excepted. The template's boot scene (src/game/boot-scene.ts) is left in place: main.ts no longer starts it, and the template's own SDK matrix harness (tests/sdk-matrix/main.ts) imports it.

Steering.notes: Keyboard (arrows, A/D) and pointer steering from the example (src/input/steering.ts).

Rushing walls.notes: Walls spawn ahead at a fixed interval and rush toward the craft, each row with a gap (src/game/simulation.ts).

Crash ends the run.notes: Any wall overlap is a crash and ends the run; revive once with a rewarded ad or race again.

Speed ramp and score.notes: Wall speed 8 rising 0.35 per second survived; score 10 per second plus 5 per wall cleared (the simulation defaults).

Game flow.notes: Menu -> playing -> pause -> crash -> revive / race again.

Kill and success criteria telemetry.notes: A run_over event (score) goes through the seam's track(); the default seam sends to NullSink until the integration wires a sink.

Platform integration.notes: Every platform call goes through src/game/integration.ts; the default implementation wraps the template's Platform and withAdBreak.

Localization.notes: All UI strings from public/locales/en.json and ru.json via src/core/i18n.ts.

Rewarded placement.notes: revive-game-over: continue the same run once, granted only when rewarded() resolves true.

Interstitial placement.notes: restart-game-over, at the break before the next drive; an unfilled ad never blocks the restart.

One content set with a data-driven diffi.notes: Walls get faster the longer the drive lasts (the simulation's speed ramp).

Score and personal best, persisted local.notes: Best score saved and loaded through the seam's save/load (platform storage).

Localization: ru, en.notes: en.json and ru.json ship in public/locales/.

how_to_play: Steer a neon craft with the arrow keys, A/D or the pointer and thread it between the walls rushing at you; the score climbs the longer you survive and the walls speed up. Crash and it is over - revive once or race again.
known_issues: This build is a deterministic REPLAY of web-game-template's examples/neon-drift-arena, ported into the template layout by the Factory's golden-run replay developer. It is not an AI-developed build and says nothing about an agent developer's ability.
Assets from the asset manifest are placeholders; the game builds every mesh procedurally and loads none of them.
